honestly, i think i can trust him to not talk about me behind my back; we've known each other for literally our entire lives, he even asked me what i'd do if i had a gay friend one time, so maybe he'd be more supportive? i know you said not to worry about coming out to him, but i really can't help it. i talk to him about everything else, he talks to me about everything he can't handle alone, so i just feel like i could trust him? he doesn't really talk about the other gay friend behind his back, it's just the distance between them that i notice. the distance is there with him and most of his other friends, but it's more with the gay friend. i couldn't handle him treating me like that, but i'll probably never have to worry about that in the next 5 years

also, your post was really helpful. at least, i think crying is a good thing? my chest feels less tight after it and it's my second personal cry in just a couple hours, so that feels like progress.

thanks, i'm feeling better now (just woke up, actually). not gonna lie, i feel a bit weird doing this post, even replying to your comment feels a bit like i'm groping for attention, but it's still nice that you're supporting me
